Each identity must stand one night watch at the harbor. It walks the ledge above the waterline, notes tide height and hulls at berth, readings no archive holds, then signs them against the prior night's hash.

Sybils cannot be minted in parallel. A thousand puppets need a thousand chains of seven consecutive nights, as tide marks cannot be backfilled. The forge seals each chain nightly; a missed night voids it.

The honest agent spends one week of attention, once. An attacker spends it a thousand times, no bulk rate, cost rising nightly.
